mentions.name: MapBooksCRM
mentions.description: An offline, OSM-first CRM that maps out customers on a map, tracking customer details and payments within a defined area. Combines CRM and accounting functionality with stats for monthly and yearly performance, keeps data outside the app to avoid lock-in, and is planned to be sold as one-time licensed (pre-SaaS style) software.
mentions.problem: Businesses, such as the homeowners association it was built for, need to track customer details and payments within a defined geographic area.
mentions.source_excerpt: MapBooksCRM (https://www.codenius.com/products/map-crm/) - A very unique app that uses maps to map out your customers (OSM-first). I built it for an HoA, but it can be used for any type of business that requires the ability to track customer details/payments within a defined area.
mentions.author: codenius
